port.name: Rio
port.description: Living Code for Rio: native terminal palettes with all sixteen ANSI slots, cursor, selections, split dividers and search colors.

guide.installation:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/living-code-theme/rio.git
cd rio
```

```sh
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/rio/themes"
cp themes/*.toml "$HOME/.config/rio/themes/"
```

In your existing Rio `config.toml`, set the top-level theme name before any tables:

```toml
theme = "living-code-night"
```

Reload or restart Rio. If your Rio installation uses a custom configuration location, put the `themes/` folder alongside that config.
guide.configuration: Each theme contains a native `[colors]` table. Rio names bright ANSI colors `light-black` through `light-white`, not `bright-*`. Cursor, vi cursor, tabs, active/inactive split dividers, selections, search matches and hints are all supplied. Remove conflicting `[colors]` entries from your main config if they override the selected theme.
guide.compatibility: Verified against Rio’s native `Theme` and `Colors` structures at the pinned upstream revision. No terminal font, renderer, keybinding or shell setting is changed. These are static TOML themes and need no build tool at runtime. All ANSI slots are tested for order and exact agreement with the pinned palette.
